acceptance_criteria.description: Historical fallback searches only commits reachable from the current canonical HEAD and rejects blobs that exist only on unrelated local or remote refs
Shallow repositories fail closed before historical review evidence recovery
Git history inspection is time bounded and malformed or ambiguous object identifiers fail closed
Cancelled success, missing current path, side-branch-only, shallow, absolute, external URI, symlink, and active issue cases are covered
Focused lab tests collaboration validation lab doctor and diff checks pass

objective: Fail closed unless terminal repository-relative review evidence is present in the current canonical HEAD ancestry of a complete Git repository, with bounded Git subprocesses and strict object identifiers.
title: Constrain terminal review recovery to canonical history
